incidents.name: UEarnPool team-level reward double counting
incidents.notes: UEarnPool.claimTeamReward() pays each level's reward from the level's configured teamAmount rather than the caller's actual team volume, so a ring of 22 self-referring contracts collected every level's bonus off one deposit.

sources.ref: onchain review: UEarnPool 0x02D841B976298DCd37ed6cC59f75D9Dd39A3690c created 2022-09-17T03:28:45Z by 0x5959e18f302db55f1e1a6933ca8c3959a4250126, unrelated to attack sender 0x645516882d8d1b2bc69f85c58164a290c92c0365; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 22,330.57 USDT left the pool in the exploit transaction.
